data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Salesforce projects averaging three to six months, with half or more of developer time spent on repetitive work.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Developing and deploying new Salesforce features and customizations took three to six months per project on average. Developers spent significant time on repetitive coding, and turning user stories into test cases took 50 to 60% of their time.

blocks.title: Technical barriers
blocks.body: Keeping code consistent, documented, and testable across projects was getting harder, and debugging took about 15% more time as a result.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Rapid prototyping, Salesforce-aware prompt engineering, and code, test case, and test script generation with human validation

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant prototyped Salesforce-specific use cases, then built a Salesforce-centric coding, test case, and test script generation solution powered by Gemini. It generates high-quality Apex and LWC code directly from user stories and automatically creates comprehensive, accurate test cases. It works from a deep understanding of Salesforce specifics, including Apex, LWC, SOQL, and governor limits, and uses advanced prompting for precise and compliant output. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: User story to code
blocks.body: Generates high-quality Apex and LWC code directly from user stories, significantly reducing development time.

blocks.title: Test case generation
blocks.body: Automatically creates comprehensive and accurate test cases, improving test coverage.

blocks.title: Test script creation
blocks.body: Produces test scripts alongside the code, speeding up the QA process.

blocks.title: Code context awareness
blocks.body: Reads active Apex classes, Lightning Web Components, triggers, and metadata as input.

blocks.title: Schema and limits awareness
blocks.body: Works from SOQL queries, the Salesforce schema of objects and fields, and governor limits.

blocks.title: Chain-of-thought for Salesforce logic
blocks.body: Keeps generated output compliant with Salesforce best practices.

blocks.title: Prompt-chaining for complex tasks
blocks.body: Breaks complex requirements into linked prompts for precise output.

blocks.title: Human feedback loop
blocks.body: The model proposes a solution, an engineer validates or corrects the reasoning, and then the final code is generated.

rows.label: Controls

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: Three to six months per project, 50 to 60% of developer time on repetitive coding and test cases, and about 15% extra time on debugging.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: User stories turned into validated Apex, LWC, test cases, and test scripts with Gemini, and an engineer confirming the reasoning.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: An admin writes a user story, such as a contact search LWC that respects sharing rules, or error handling for DML operations in a batch Apex job. Gemini reads the Salesforce context, reasons through the logic step by step, and proposes the code with its test cases and scripts. An engineer validates the reasoning, and a user story that took 8 hours to turn into Apex is ready in 2.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: Faster Salesforce releases at half the development cost, with an engineer validating every output.

blocks.body: The Salesforce-aware prompting pattern, with org context, chain-of-thought, and human validation, now feeds Agivant's CPQ Lens accelerator. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Getting generated code to follow Salesforce best practices and governor limits on every output, which is why chain-of-thought prompting and engineer validation sit inside the workflow.
